children: Gollagunta will lead the evaluation of a potential new growth opportunity for the Mahindra Group, while Suri takes charge of automotive sales, marketing and customer-facing functions

Mahindra & Mahindra is reshuffling its automotive leadership, with current Automotive Division CEO Nalinikanth Gollagunta moving to a group-level role and Shuchi Suri taking charge of sales and marketing for the automotive business from April 1, 2027.

Gollagunta has been appointed Executive Vice-President and Head of Corporate Development. Based at Mahindra’s Worli headquarters in Mumbai, he will report to Group CEO and Managing Director Anish Shah. His new mandate will involve evaluating and developing a potential strategic growth opportunity for the Mahindra Group.

Shah has indicated that the proposed opportunity will be assessed on the group’s ability to establish a strong competitive position, achieve meaningful scale and deliver returns above industry benchmarks.

Gollagunta has led Mahindra’s Automotive Division as CEO since April 2023. He brings more than 22 years of experience across India, the US and Southeast Asia, having previously worked with General Electric, Cisco, McKinsey and Texas Instruments.

As part of the transition, Shuchi Suri, currently Executive Vice-President of Mahindra Experiences, will become Chief Sales and Marketing Officer of Automotive Business. She will oversee sales, marketing, customer care, charging infrastructure and accessories, reporting to R Velusamy, President of Automotive Business.

Mahindra disclosed Suri’s transition in a regulatory filing dated November 5, 2026. She joined the group in May 2026 after a career spanning more than two decades at Unilever, where she held leadership positions across India, Asia-Pacific and global markets.
